settings.name: lunar_prescribed_p2
settings.forcing: Uniform local 3 mm/h column ceiling, original seed flux and mass/dimension distribution, initially empty ice column. Prescribed mode shares the ceiling across native trial growth increments; reservoir modes add vapor up to that ceiling and liquid saturation.
settings.unmatched: Native evolving porous spheroid geometry, Bohm drag and constant ice efficiency 0.1; spherical injected shapes with matched mass and maximum dimension. Ballistic settling; no chipping. Native dry-air thermodynamic constants. 8 columns of weighted particles, not the custom finite individual-particle volume.

lunar_prescribed_p2.evidence: Numerical comparison under declared artificial forcing, not measured snow or a mechanically validated upper size. Prescribed runs change several native closures together; reservoir and thermal contrasts isolate atmospheric-feedback choices within SCALE.

custom_ballistic_without_chipping.evidence: Continuous-mass finite-volume particle calculation with inherited geometry, drag, sticking, chipping and liquid-saturated growth. Collision events are exact at fixed layer properties; volume, vertical mixing, split-time, fractional-fragment allocation and sampling errors remain distinct. No observed-storm calibration or giant-aggregate survival law.
custom_ballistic_without_chipping.reading_rule: The final null diameter means +infinity and retains all arrivals. Moment arrays are unnormalized cumulative extensive quantities per square metre. Quantiles are per realization. Fractional fragments retain water and number in local allocation remainders, participate after allocation of a whole particle, and are bounded separately; no fragment water is discarded. The demand bound excludes delayed-allocation feedback. Physical tail predictions require convergence and suitable geometry, fracture and cloud exposure.

evidence: Full-duration numerical sensitivity and refinement calculations. Matched lunar forcing, different microphysical closures. No lunar observation, contact-fracture validation or predicted storm optics.
reading_rule: Use the eight-column mean/standard-error summaries for comparisons with original means of realization quantiles; pooled arrival quantiles are retained separately. Native packet refinement is distinct from custom individual-particle statistical-volume refinement. The timestep comparison holds injected packets per minute fixed while refining their release timing. Reservoir experiments start with 48.34 kg/m2 vapor and impose a source ceiling, rather than an instantaneous deposition ceiling. Native thermal experiment has no imposed radiative/dynamical cooling. Neither moisture allowance is an observed storm supply.
